title: A ring buffer
description:
Write a fixed-size queue that wraps around an array.

```
push 1 2 3 4 (capacity 4) -> full
pop -> 1, push 5
contents: 2 3 4 5
push 6 -> refused (full)
```
hints: The next free slot is `(m_head + m_count) % N` (lesson 1.05).
requirements: `template <typename T, std::size_t N> class RingBuffer` with `push`, `pop` (returning `std::optional<T>`), `size`, `empty` and `full`.
Keep a head index and a count; positions wrap with `% N`.
stretch: Add an overwrite mode that drops the oldest item when full, as audio buffers do.
